clips.title: The story
paras: In Hillsbrad Foothills, Powdered Azurite is taken from the Azurelode Mine. Thun'grim Firegaze needs it to forge brutal armor for rising Horde warriors.

Powdered Azurite comes from the mineral veins beneath Hillsbrad Foothills. Human workers dig the blue stone from Azurelode Mine, then grind and pack it for trade and metalworking. A skilled smith mixes the dust with dense metals to make armor more durable and resilient.

Horde blacksmiths prize Powdered Azurite for its strength in metalworking, though it comes from human-held tunnels across the Great Sea. Thun'grim Firegaze, an aging orc armorer in the Barrens, asks for small amounts alongside refined iron and fiery reagents. Mixed into the smelt, the powder helps him hammer out the heavy plating of his Brutal Armor.
